name: Kodama Sound
description: Kodama Sound is a calm, photo-led WordPress portfolio theme crafted for sound designers, composers, and audio post houses. Built on quiet typography and documentary imagery, it features ruled credit sheets, tactile audio schedules, and structured project showcases for pitching to film directors and game studios. It provides an unhurried, exact aesthetic.
